description: Explore cutting the fixed per-step cost (Muon ~1.5 ms/step after E024, plus Lookahead and launch costs) in the cheap low-res phase. On E025, use batch 3072 in the 24 px phase only (epochs 1-5, 16 steps/epoch with drop_last instead of 32). In that phase, scale the Muon lr by sqrt(2) (0.29) and the SGD-group lr linearly (2x), with momentum unchanged. Keep batch 1536 at 28 and 32 px. Define the LR schedule per step over the new total step count, keeping the same epoch boundaries. Capture the 24 px graph at batch 3072 in build (one graph per resolution, as now).
